thread:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: control-plane packet loss spike in eu-west1. Multiple control-plane health checks failing -> high kubelet churn. Incident ID: INC-2039-euw1
jamie_ops: seeing a huge increase in 5xx from hosted-api for EU customers, ~35% failure rate. Graphs show RPC timeouts to control-plane and node NotReady flaps.
sara_oncall: P1. Starting triage. Net + Infra please join: @mike_net @leo_infra @tamara_sre
mike_net: running traceroutes and checking BGP. Initial traces show intermittent blackholing at a provider PoP in eu-west1 (see snippet).
leo_infra: GPU node reachability down. Autoscaler trying to add nodes but kubelets crash shortly after join. ~40% of eu-west1 GPU pool NotReady.
jamie_ops: any infra config pushes in last hour? Might be unrelated but need to rule it out.
tamara_sre: no infra/control-plane deploys in last 90m. Provider side looks suspicious.
mike_net: traceroute excerpt:
```
traceroute to api.redwood-euw1.internal (10.12.3.7), 30 hops max
 1  10.1.0.1  0.45 ms
 2  100.64.0.2  1.2 ms
 3  203.0.113.45  *  *  *
 4  198.51.100.12  120 ms  118 ms  119 ms
```
mike_net: hop 3 intermittently drops packets. Edge retransmits and AS path jitter visible.
sara_oncall: impact summary: EU-region API latency and 5xx spike. Recommend immediate traffic shift to avoid data plane impact. Suggest eu-west2 + eu-central1 as targets.
leo_infra: prefer staged weight shift. Full cutover will pressure on-demand pool and cost. We'll warm caches and pre-provision nodes.
jamie_ops: runbook: initial weights 60%->eu-west2, 30%->eu-central1, 10%->keep for health checks. Dry-run command:
```
rw-route set --region eu-west1 --weight 10 --region eu-west2 --weight 60 --region eu-central1 --weight 30 --dry-run
```
jamie_ops: dry-run OK, proceeding with canary (20% -> eu-west2, 10% -> eu-central1). Monitoring canary subset.
deploy-bot: rw-route dry-run OK: route-map validated, no conflicts.
tamara_sre: note: cross-region KV cache misses will spike token usage and could change output latencies. Enable prefix warmers for top keys on new paths.
leo_infra: starting cache warmers and prefetch for common prefixes. Also kicking off accelerated provisioning for eu-west2 and eu-central1 GPU pools. ETA ~3m per node.
mike_net: opened ticket with provider NOC. Provider ticket PKT-84213. Requested BGP/logs and immediate investigation at affected PoP.
sara_oncall: once canary stable for 3m, do full 60/30/10. Keep rollback steps ready.
jamie_ops: canary looks good: errors down ~60% on canary traffic. Proceeding to full 60/30/10.
deploy-bot: rw-route applied. New weights live.
monitoring-bot: metric update: eu-west1 request rate down 65%, global 5xx reduced from 34% -> 8% over last 6m.
leo_infra: autoscaler created additional on-demand GPU nodes in eu-west2 and eu-central1. If sustained, cost delta estimated at +$3k/hr. Flagging CostOps.
tamara_sre: enabling circuit-breakers and retry budget limits on high-latency routes to avoid retry storms.
mike_net: provider update: transient fiber splice / PoP issue identified, mitigation in progress. They recommend keeping traffic off affected PoP until confirmed stable.
sara_oncall: agreed. Keep weights away from eu-west1. Starting postmortem channel and evidence collection.
jamie_ops: recording timeline and actions for PM. Next steps: maintain current routing, monitor node health, and track spend. Escalate to Eng Leads if provisioning > threshold.
leo_infra: note to Finance/CostOps: if burst nodes >2h, consider reserved capacity transfer for impacted accounts.
sara_oncall: follow-ups assigned: @mike_net provider comms, @leo_infra kubelet crash logs & cleanup, @tamara_sre cache + CB tuning, @jamie_ops postmortem draft.
jamie_ops: thanks all. I'll keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
monitoring-bot: INCIDENT-2039-euw1 status -> mitigated (external routing workaround in place). Confirm when ready to close.
